༄༅/ /bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal tshe bdag lcags sdig nag po'i phrin las dgra bgegs tshar gcod srog gi spu gri'i lhan thabs yig chung gud du sbas pa bzhu

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal tshe bdag lcags sdig nag po'i phrin las dgra bgegs tshar gcod srog gi spu gri'i lhan thabs yig chung gud du sbas pa bzhugs so//

lcags sdig nag po'i lhan thabs la/ dang po gtor ma'i bca' gzhi ni/ rgyas par ni/ tshe bdag rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor rdul tshon nam 'brus bris pa'i dkyil 'khor lha gnas so sor gtso bo'i gtor ma dpal bshos zur gsum pa brjid ldan thod pa mtshan ngan du bca' zhing*/ gzhan rnams thod dum du bzhag pa lha gnas so sor ma 'chol bar bkod de/ 'di ni gtor sgrub tsam gyi dus ma gtogs bsnyen sgrub las sbyor la gal mi che'o// yang na dkyil 'khor dbus su mda' lnga/ phur lnga sogs bstod bskul chen po nas 'byung ba ltar sgrub rdzas bkod kyang nyan no// 'bring po ni| ri rab bang rim bdun pa'i steng du gtso bo'i dpal bshos/ de'i g.yas g.yon du dbyings sgrol gyi yum gnyis la bshos bu re re/ de'i phyogs bzhir bshos bu bzhi/ de'i mthar gsum/ bang rim gnyis pa'i phyogs bzhir re re/ gsum pa'i phyogs mtshams su re re/ bzhi pa'i phyogs re rer gsum re/ lnga pa'i mdun du gsum dang*/ g.yas g.yon rgyab rnams su gnyis re/ drug pa'i phyogs bzhir brgyad re/ bdun pa'i phyogs bzhir re re/ ri rab kyi rtsa bar/ chang bu/ ong skyu/ ril bu/ sha dum rnam grangs ci mang*/ tsher ma can gyi rtsang gis bskor/ bsdus pa ni/ lcags snod dam rus sbal gyi khog pa'i thod par lha gtso bo'i dpal bshos kyi mthar lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i gtor chung gis bskor ro// de ltar rgyas bsdus gang byed kyang gtso bo'i steng du khyung dang gdugs mthing nag /ri rab kyi rtsa ba'i phyogs mtshams rnams su ru dar dang rgyal mtshan/ gtor ma rnams la rtsang dang mtshe yungs khram byang*/ phyi skor du drag po'i shing gi rtsang stod gri khrag dang smad ro sol gyis sbags pa bsnol ba'i dra mig rnams su mtshe yungs kyis brgyan/ gtor ma rnams srung zlog la dmigs na dkar dmar gyis brgyan cing sha khrag gis sbags pa dang*/ bsad pa la rgyan med sha khrag gis sbags pa dgod/

gzhan yang mchod gtor dpal bshos nag po la lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i bshos bus bskor ba dkar dmar gyis brgyan pa dang*/ sman raka mchod 'bul sogs mthong rgyud ltar bya'o// gtor ma'i bca' gzhi 'bring dang bsdus pa gnyis po ni lcags sdig gi sgrub pa dang*/ las sbyor spyang mo drug dang*/ 'khor lo bcu gsum steng bcas/ bar bcas/ 'og bcas sogs thams cad la dgos pa yin zhing bsnyen pa'i dus ni bsdus pa kho nas 'thus so// yang chog gzhung rang rang ma gtogs dbyings sgrol kyi yum dang*/ ded dpon bzhi mi sbyor na gong du bshad pa de'i gtor ma mi dgos so// yum dang ded dpon bzhi bskyed par 'dod na mngon rtogs kyi skabs sprul pa gsum gyi gong du/ gtso bo'i g.yon du sgrol ba'i yum chen ni// e ka tsā ti sngon mo mi lpags dang*// re lde'i gos kyis stod smad rab bklubs shing*// thod sbrul gyis brgyan ral pa nyi zla dang*// nor bus spras shing g.yas pa ral gri dang*// g.yon pa lcags spyang mgo dgu dgra la 'gyed// baṃ ro'i gdan la brjid 'gying gar gyis rtsen// g.yas su dbyings yum srid pa'i rgyal mo ni// mthing nag mi lpags gos gyon byu rus brgyan// sku smad stag sham thod sbrul dar gyis brgyan// ral pa spyi bor 'khyil zhing rma byas mtshan// g.yas pas khram shing g.yon pas nad rkyal bsnams// de'i phyir shar du dri za me lha'i steng*| |lha yi ded dpon dkar po seng ge'i gdong*// dred lpags gyon zhing spu gri snying phreng thogs// rang 'dra'i yum bcas lha rnams zil gyis gnon// lho ru gshin rje srin po bsnol ba'i steng*// srog bdag ded dpon dmar po stag gi mgo// mi lpags gos gyon spu gri snying phreng thogs// rang 'dra'i yum bcas srog bdag srin po sdud// nub tu klu dbang rlung lha bsnol ba'i steng*// klu yi ded dpon nag po sbrul gyi mgo// sbrul mgo'i gdengs ka dgus brgyan rus sbal gyi// g.yang gzhi gyon zhing khram shing snying phreng bsnams// rang 'dra'i yum bcas klu rnams bran tu 'khol// byang du gnod sbyin dbang ldan bsnol ba'i steng*// bgegs kyi ded dpon mthing nag khyung gi mgo// sku la bya rgod dar ma'i g.yang gzhi gsol// phyag gnyis ral gri dgra snying phreng ba bsnams// rang 'dra'i yum bcas za 'dre dbang du sdud// ces bskyed/

spyan 'dren gyi skabs su sku gsung thugs sprul gyi gong du/ dbyings sgrol yum chen 'bar ba gshegs su gsol// bka' yi ded dpon rnam bzhi gshegs su gsol// zhes dang*/ sman mchod skabs su/ sku gsung thugs sprul gyi gong du/ sgrol ba'i yum chen khro mo ral chen dang*// dbyings kyi yum mchog srid pa'i rgyal mor bcas// bka' yi ded dpon chen po mched bzhi la// rnam dag sogs phrin bcol gyi sprul pa rnam gsum gyi sngon du/ dbyings sgrol yum chen gnyis= bka' yi ded dpon bzhi= /zhes dang*/ bstod pa'i skabs/ zla gam gsum la sku gsung thugs sprul pa'i// zhes pa'i sngon du/ sgrol yum khro mo e ka tsā ti dang*// dbyings yum 'bar ba srid pa'i rgyal mo dang*// bka' yi ded dpon gdong can 'bar ba bzhi// rang rang yum dang bcas la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces dang*/ dam can spyi bskul gyi skabs su/ gru gsum 'bar ba'i zla gam gzhal yas nas// zhes pa'i sngon du/ khro rgyal 'bar ba'i g.yas g.yon brjid pa nas// dbyings sgrol yum chen gnyis kyi thugs dam bskul// chos 'byung mthing nag yangs pa'i phyogs bzhi nas// bka' yi ded dpon bzhi yi= /zhes dang*/ bkra shis kyi skabs su/ sku gsung thugs kyi gsang gsum zhes pa'i sngon du/ sgrol ba'i yum chen khro mo raka gdong ma// dbyings kyi yum mchog srid pa'i rgyal mo dang*// bka' yi ded dpon gdong can rngam pa bzhi// rang rang yum bcas 'jigs pa'i bkra shis shog /ces pa so so'i skabs thob tu gnas ma 'chol bar bkod pa ni zab phyir gud du sbas pa yin no// lha bskyed lugs kyang gzhung gi mngon rtogs dang*/ sgrub thabs dang*/ bstod bskul rnams kyang cung zad 'dra min yod cing lcags sdig rang gi yig cha gzhan rnams nas 'dra min mang du gsungs pa ni phal cher bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi bskyed tshul dang skabs thob yin pas the tshom mi bya la/

yang lha 'god lugs kyang sgrub thabs dang mngon rtogs bstod bskul la lar/ dbus ling tshe dgu byas pa'i shar du phyag rdor/ lhor ya ma rā dza/ nub tu rus sbal/ byang du mkha' lding*/ mtshams bzhi ded dpon bzhi/ zla gam gsum la sprul pa gsum/ de'i phyir 'khor lo thod mkhar bcu gnyis byas pa la gsang ba'i gshed ya ma rā dza sogs bzhi/ nang gi gshed dung gi mon pa sogs bzhi/ phyi'i gshed he le khyab pa sogs bzhi rnams bskyed| de'i phyir lcags mkhar bcu gnyis la 'chi bdag bcu gnyis/ de'i phyir 'obs dang sgrol ging bco brgyad med par zhag gshed dang sgo ba bzhi sogs bskyed pa'i lugs kyang yod pas/ bskyed tshul gnyis po gang bde las phal cher las byang 'di nyid ltar byas na bsnyen sgrub las sbyor kun la khebs che bar sems so// sngags bzla ba'i tshe/ a+yai ring dang a+ye thung sku gsung thugs kyi sngags rnams las byang du gsal la/ yang lha so so'i phreng sngags bzla bar 'dod na/ a+ye a kro te ka ya mān+ta ka kā la rū pa hrīḥṣ+ṭī a pa ye hūm̐/ e be tā lī kro dhī shwa rī hūm̐/ e ma ma e ka tsā ti hūm̐/ e dhe ma kā lī baṃ ril maṃ ru lu ru lu bh+yo hūm̐/ e badz+ra kro dha tsaṇ+ḍa ro ṣa ṇa hūm̐/ e ya ma rā dza kro dha hūm̐| e ma hā bhe ru kā la hūm̐/ e khroṃ ga ru ḍa hūm̐/ e ka he dun ya ma rā dza hūm̐/ e ya ma du sha hūm̐/ e ya ma rak+sha hūm̐/ e ya ma yak+sha hūm̐/ ya ma rā tsa sa do me ya/ ya me do ru ṇa yo da ya/ ya da yo ni ra ya k+ṣe ya/ ya k+ṣe ya tsa ni ra ma ya/ tsaṇ+ḍa ru dra mon+ta dzaḥ ya ma mon+ta dzaḥ rak+sha mon+ta dzaḥ yak+sha mon+ta dzaḥ du tri ru lu ha ha ya/ du ru ya ma snying du na/ ru tra bha ti ru sha ya/ du tra yak+sha tig+na ya/ e ya ma rā dza/ kro ne kro ne/ pa tra pa tra/ shū la shū la/ da sha grī ba/ yak+sha grī ba/ ru lu ru lu/ ha ha ya ya/ bdud ru dra ha la nag po/ ya ma du na rak+sha ya/

ru ru tsa pa la kha la rak+mo thun bh+yo/ yak+sha tiṃ baṃ bh+yo/ tri tsa pa la a shu me ya/ ru tra du ru ya/ yak+sha ru lu ha ha ya/ ya ma ya ma/ du na du na/ shaṃ shaṃ/ ghṛ ṇa ghṛ ṇa/ pa tsa pa tsa/ hu ya hu ya/ be ra be ra/ ha la ha la/ hu la ya/ ma ma ru ru/ nag po ha dhe hṛ ta ya/ nṛ la dun bh+yo/ dun bh+yo ya/ zhes pa gtso 'khor so so'i phreng sngags dril ba ste/ 'di la'ang brgya stong tsam bzlas na legs so// yang a+yai ring lcags thag sum sbrel ni/ rnal zlog dkrug gsum ste lcags sdig gzhung du gsal la/ mchod rten gyi steng cha bsrung ba'i a+yai ring ni/ mon+ta'i mjug tu/ a mu ka myag thuṃ ril trig nan sbur ya nan/ e hur thuṃ dzaḥ khaṃ shag ro myag muk+ti rbad ya/ zhes btags so// mchod rten gyi bar cha bzlog pa'i a+yai ring ni/ a+yai ring gi sham bur spyang mo drug 'dogs pa ste/ spyang mo drug skabs don gyis so sor 'dogs pa dang*/ tshan che zhing myur ba'i ched du bsdoms nas 'dogs pa ste lugs gnyis las// dang po so sor 'dogs pa ni/ a+yai ring mon+ta'i mjug tu rbod gtong mkhan gyi las kyi lha sde brgyad gang yin pa'i sgos srog sngags rkang re dang*/ de'i mthar dgra'i ming rus dang*/ de'i mthar spyang mo 'dogs tshul ni/ dper na rbod gtong mkhan gyi las lha gshin rje lta bu yin par mtshon na/ mon+ta'i mjug tu/ oṃ ya ma ya/ dgra bo che ge mo zhes pa'i mthar pha rol po'i lha dang byed mkhan gzir zhing stobs bshig pa'i tshe dgra'i ming mthar/ a mu ka myag thuṃ ril/ trig nan/ e hur thuṃ dzaḥ khaṃ shag ro myag muk+ti rbad ya/ zhes sbyar ba ni gzir zhing stobs bshig nas bdag bsrung ba'i spyang mo yin no// de bzhin du pha rol pos bdag la rbod gtong byas pa bshig pa'i spyang mo ni/ sbyor tshul gong ltar la/ che ge mo a mu ka rtsa sbur srog nan/ snying gzir breng shag yaṃ rbad/ e hur thuṃ dzaḥ khaṃ shag ro myag muk+ti rbad ya/

zhes so| |yang rbod gtong mkhan gyi byad kha dang sde brgyad kyi za kha sogs zug pa dbyung ba'i spyang mo ni/ sbyor tshul gong ltar la/ che ge mo a mu ka du raṃ tri yaṃ 'drid phyung srog la gzir nan phyung*/ e hur thuṃ dzaḥ khaṃ shag ro myag muk+ti rbad ya/ zhes so// yang gzhan gyi mthu gtad la sogs sbyor ngan dang lha dang sde brgyad kyi gsang lam dgag pa'i spyang mo ni/ sbyor lugs snga ma ltar la/ che ge mo a mu ka daṃ ta duṃ duṃ ma hā rā ga du raṃ thuṃ ril rbad/ e hur thuṃ dzaḥ khaṃ shag ro myag muk+ti rbad ya/ zhes so/ yang rbod gtong mkhan gyis byas pa'i ngan sbyor phar la bzlog pa'i spyang mo ni/ sbyor tshul gong ltar la/ che ge mo a mu ka e nan yaṃ zlog 'drid bh+yo/ e hur thuṃ dzaḥ khaṃ shag ro myag muk+ti rbad ya/ zhes so// yang ban dgra la sogs pa ngag mnan pa'i spyang mo ni/ sbyor tshul snga ma ltar la/ che ge mo a mu ka bi dang s+t+waṃ bha ya nan/ e hur thuṃ dzaḥ khaṃ shag ro myag muk+ti rbad ya| zhes sbyar zhing*/ sngar ltar gshin rje la dpe bzhag pa'i mtshams der pha rol po'i las kyi lha ngo shes na de nyid la bstim/ ma shes na phyi nang rtags kyis ngos 'dzin nas bshad pa ltar sde brgyad kyi cho 'phrul rmi lam sogs su gang byung de bstim/ des kyang ma shes na sde brgyad dril la bstims shing rmi ltas nang rtags dang sbyar la tshod zin par bya'o// yang byad ltas shin tu che ba'am sgrub pa yun ring por byed pa'i long med pa'am/ rno zhing tshan che ba'i phyir/ spyang mo drug dril nas gdogs na/ mon+ta'i mjug tu sde brgyad gyi sgos srog gi mthar/ dgra bo che ge mo a mu ka myag thuṃ ril/ trig nan sbur ya nan/ rtsa sbur srog nan snying gzir breng shag yaṃ rbad/ du raṃ tri yaṃ 'drid phyung srog la gzir nan phyung*/ daṃ ta duṃ duṃ ma hā rā ga du raṃ thuṃ ril rbad/ e nan yaṃ zlog 'drid bh+yoḥ

bi dang s+t+waṃ bha ya nan/ e hur thuṃ dzaḥ khaṃ shag ro myag muk+ti rbad ya/ zhes dril la bzla'o| |de ltar spyang mo las drug so so dang*/ dril ba'i sham bu sbyor tshul 'di ni zhal gdams shin tu gsang ba'i zab rgya'o// gzhan lcags sdig gi las sbyor so so'i sngags rnams ni rang gzhung so so nas 'byung ba ltar las byang gi bsnyen pa'i mtshams su so so'i dmigs pa dang bcas bzla dgos so// yang mchod rten gyi smad bcas bsad pa'i a+yai ring ni/ spyir btang du bsad mnan la a+yai ring la 'byung ba'i spu gri sham bu btags pa tsam dang*/ bye brag las sbyor 'khor lo bcu gsum sogs gang dgos skabs bstun la so so'i bcas dang sngags kyi bzla tshul sdig pa'i chos skor so so nas 'byung ba ltar bya ba ni gnad dam pa yin no// zhes pa'ang gshin rje lcags sdig gi las byang kho bos bgyis pa'i lhan thabs su yig chung nyer mkhor/ 'bri gung pa chos kyi grags pas sbyar ba yin zhing shin tu gsang ba'i gnad 'gag 'ga' zhig ni slob dpon dgyes pa'i gsung gi gsang ba las rtogs par bya ba kho na yin no// //sarba maṅga laṃ//
